title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## User problem

What should become easier, more useful or more personal for the user?

## Proposed experience

Describe what the user sees and does. Avoid describing only internal or kernel terminology.

## Why it belongs in Eagle

Explain which existing Eagle capability it builds on and why people would use it repeatedly.

## Safety and fallback

What should Eagle do on an unsupported device or when the operation cannot be verified?

## References or mockups

Attach visuals or primary technical references when available.
